summary:
Shipped the shim; the journal name is now `MU/TH/ER 使用说明` and the register records the dependency both ways.

**Verdict on risk: the wrap is safe, and narrower than the brief assumed.** `getName` has exactly one implementation in this Foundry build — `foundry.utils.Collection.prototype.getName` at `common/utils/collection.mjs:134`. `DocumentCollection`, `WorldCollection` and `Journal` do not override it. So an own, **non-enumerable** `getName` on the `game.journal` **instance** shadows the only implementation with zero reach into `game.actors`, `game.items`, or any CompendiumCollection. No libWrapper (the project doesn't depend on it); a guarded own-property wrapper with the unique sentinel `__alienrpgCnGetNamePatched`.

**Call sites re-derived — there are five unguarded derefs, not four.** `init.mjs:81` `.show()`, `init.mjs:107` `.show()`, `alienrpg.mjs:592` `.id`, `alienrpg.mjs:613→614` `.setFlag()`, and `migratefolders.js:120` `.show()`. Guarded: `alienrpg.mjs:574` and `migratefolders.js:43`. The register had listed four — `migratefolders.js:120` sat outside its live-import-graph scope.

**Installed at `setup`, and that is load-bearing.** `client/game.mjs:730` creates `game.journal`, `:740` fires `setup`, `:779` fires `ready`. `i18nInit` (`:663`) is too early — no `game.journal` yet — and `ready` is too late, because systems load before modules, so the system's own `ready` handler reaches `FirstTimeSetup()` first.

The shim also earns its keep on a path that was already broken: `showReleaseNotes()` rewrites the world journal from the Babele-translated pack, renaming it to Chinese in place, then looks it up by the English name on the very next line — inside an **empty** catch. Without the shim that fails silently forever.

**Suite: PASS 397 / FAIL 0** (was 300/0; group S adds 97). Positive, negatives, and the `lang !== 'cn'` inertness case are all there, and they run the *shipped* `installNameFallback`, not a copy. I mutation-tested four ways — removing the install point, making the wrapper over-fire, drifting the pack name, drifting the page name — and every one goes red, then green again on restore.

**One thing you need to know.** Regenerating `DO-NOT-TRANSLATE.json` tripped the hazard `PROJECT.md:677` had already flagged: `build_register.py` no longer reproduces that file, and the run deleted 410 keys and silently reverted 14 hand-verified values. I restored it from a pre-run backup and merged only the shim deltas (leaf-diff: 0 lost), then gave the generator a destructive-overwrite guard so the next run exits 2 with an itemised loss list instead of quietly eating the file. Re-syncing the generator is still owed. Also unverified in a live world — the hub runs on the VPS, so first proof is a fresh-world load showing the journal named 「MU/TH/ER 使用说明」 and `alienrpg-cn | 已装载 getName 译名回退（1 条）` in the console at setup.
